en: Self-hosted runner: Changed Linux and macOS sessions with no `gh` to get a built-in `gh api` by default, via Anthropic, which adds their GitHub sign-in, if any; `--use-anthropic-gh false` turns it off
zh: 自托管运行器：没有 `gh` 的 Linux 和 macOS session 现在默认通过 Anthropic 获得内置的 `gh api`，并附带其 GitHub 登录（如有）；`--use-anthropic-gh false` 可关闭此行为
